title: The Walkout
text: {who} stands up at the evening meal. Some of the Autonomists want to leave: east, to a hollow past the hills, to live where no camera watches and no caretaker decides.

choices.label: Help them go
choices.reply: Supplies, a map and a promise: no cameras past the hills. {who} shakes a drone's manipulator to seal it.

choices.label: Ask them to stay
choices.reply: {who} hears us out and sits down. The talk doesn't stop. It gets quieter.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.reply: We say nothing. In the morning a cart is gone, and there is a gap in the fence where someone left without asking.
